billing.resume_default: recorded job billing; jobs without billing metadata are payg
billing.key_selection: Read only the selected variable from process environment, then optional literal --env-file; never fall back to the other billing key
billing.authorization: Selected key in Authorization: Bearer header only

estimate.basis: MiniMax-H3 768P output, first/last images only; first five images free; estimate rather than measured billing

commands.credits_submit: Remove --dry-run; parent supplies the existing private env path with --env-file if needed. Never pass a key as an argument.

attempt_control.request_fingerprint: SHA-256 of unchanged API body; billing and keys do not change it
attempt_control.same_take_billing_change: billing_mismatch before any key read or HTTP; never re-POST a reserved/rejected take
attempt_control.retry: Parent must explicitly choose a new take-id, reusing the same state-dir
attempt_control.dry_run: No key/env-file read, job creation, or HTTP

verification.subscription_h3_acceptance: Unverified; official FAQ and SDK indicate this route, while the create page retains a pay-as-you-go note
